column1: # Deskripsi SKILL — putaran ketiga puluh tujuh ekor panjang.
# Bagian 1 dari lima berkas (70-74). Tetap 1:1, harfiah ("=").
# Mulai putaran ini urutannya BUKAN lagi "penghalang satu kalimat" (tinggal 40),
# melainkan frekuensi seluruh kalimat sisa. Frekuensi tertingginya cuma 8, jadi
# ekornya rata — tidak ada lagi jalan pintas, semua harus ditulis satu per satu.
# Salah ketik permainan yang disalin apa adanya:
#   "this unit and it's summons"   (mestinya "its")
# --- klausa pembatas ---

column1: =After using this skill, Belka can use the active skill <color=#3487e0>Sylvan Vault</color> or her basic attack <color=#3487e0>Nutcracker Shell</color>.
column2: Setelah memakai skill ini, Belka bisa memakai skill aktif <color=#3487e0>Sylvan Vault</color> atau basic attack <color=#3487e0>Nutcracker Shell</color>.

column1: =After skill usage, Lind can use the active skill <color=#3487e0>Assault Spray</color>, the active skill <color=#3487e0>Overwhelming Burst</color>, or the basic attack <color=#3487e0>Repulsive Shot</color>.
column2: Setelah skill dipakai, Lind bisa memakai skill aktif <color=#3487e0>Assault Spray</color>, skill aktif <color=#3487e0>Overwhelming Burst</color>, atau basic attack <color=#3487e0>Repulsive Shot</color>.

column1: =If there are no empty tiles to charge to, shoots the enemy target to deal damage instead.
column2: Jika tidak ada tile kosong untuk diterjang, justru menembak target musuh untuk memberikan damage.

column1: =If Lainie does not have enough Confectance Index, her Simulacrum vanishes.
column2: Jika Confectance Index Lainie tidak cukup, Simulacrum-nya lenyap.

column1: # --- serangan ---
=Attacks 1 enemy character, dealing X% damage and applying Taunt for 1 turn.
column2: Menyerang 1 karakter musuh, memberikan X% damage lalu menerapkan Taunt selama 1 giliran.

column1: =Selects 1 direction and deals AoE <color=#d4ae08>Electric damage</color> equal to <color=#f26c1c>110%</color> of attack to all enemy units within 8 tiles in that direction.
column2: Memilih 1 arah dan memberikan AoE <color=#d4ae08>Electric damage</color> setara <color=#f26c1c>110%</color> Attack ke semua unit musuh dalam 8 tile ke arah itu.

column1: =At the end of the heavy weapons team's action, select the enemy target on the <color=#f26c1c>Peripheral Battlefield 1</color> or Core Battlefield with the lowest HP.
column2: Di akhir aksi heavy weapons team, memilih target musuh dengan HP terendah di <color=#f26c1c>Peripheral Battlefield 1</color> atau Core Battlefield.

column1: =Damage multiplier is increased based on the amount of mobility expended.
column2: Damage multiplier meningkat berdasarkan jumlah Mobility yang dipakai.

column1: =After this skill resolves, triggers all Corrosion debuffs held by all enemy units within this skill's effective range.
column2: Setelah skill ini bekerja, memicu semua debuff Corrosion yang dimiliki unit musuh dalam jangkauan efektif skill ini.

column1: =If Corrosion damage is dealt, Corrosion damage dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.
column2: Jika Corrosion damage diberikan, Corrosion damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>.

column1: =Damage increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> against targets without buffs.
column2: Damage meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> terhadap target yang tidak memiliki buff.

column1: =If the target has a debuff, damage is increased by an additional <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Jika target memiliki debuff, damage meningkat tambahan <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =For targets with lower HP percentage than the user, increase critical damage by <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.
column2: Untuk target yang persentase HP-nya lebih rendah dari pengguna, Critical Damage bertambah sebesar <color=#f26c1c>20%</color>.

column1: =After each attack in the current round, the damage of the next skill increases by <color=#f26c1c>4%</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>16%</color>.
column2: Setelah setiap serangan pada ronde ini, damage skill berikutnya meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>4%</color>, maksimal <color=#f26c1c>16%</color>.

column1: =After the unit or an allied unit launches a Support Attack, the critical rate of its next active attack is increased by <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.
column2: Setelah unit ini atau unit sekutu melancarkan Support Attack, Critical Rate serangan aktif berikutnya meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>10%</color>, maksimal <color=#f26c1c>30%</color>.

column1: =Additionally, Electric damage dealt is permanently increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>, and stability damage dealt is permanently increased by <color=#f26c1c>1 point</color>.
column2: Selain itu, Electric damage yang diberikan meningkat permanen <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>, dan Stability damage yang diberikan bertambah permanen <color=#f26c1c>1 poin</color>.

column1: =Critical Damage of all allied Physical Summons is increased by <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.
column2: Critical Damage semua Physical Summon sekutu meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>5%</color>.

column1: =When allied units deal Physical damage by active attacks, ignores <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> of the enemy target's defense.
column2: Saat unit sekutu memberikan Physical damage lewat serangan aktif, mengabaikan <color=#f26c1c>10%</color> Defense target musuh.

column1: =Damage dealt to enemy units in the Core Battlefield is increased; when all enemy units in the Peripheral Battlefield are eliminated, its own damage dealt is increased.
column2: Damage ke unit musuh di Core Battlefield meningkat; saat semua unit musuh di Peripheral Battlefield habis, damage yang diberikannya sendiri meningkat.

column1: =Gains <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> of <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> for each instance of damage dealt.
column2: Mendapat <color=#f26c1c>1 stack</color> <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> untuk setiap kali damage diberikan.

column1: =At the end of the action, recovers HP equal to <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> of Max HP.
column2: Di akhir aksi, memulihkan HP setara <color=#f26c1c>5%</color> Max HP.

column1: =Before using a normal attack or active skill, this unit and it's summons gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> and <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.
column2: Sebelum memakai normal Attack atau skill aktif, unit ini dan summon-nya mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> selama <color=#f26c1c>2 giliran</color>.
